messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: DataTables in Shiny?
parts:
I have tried working with this in the past. The main issue is that DataTables expects tables to contain thead and tbody tags clearly outlining the column headers from the body.

Unfortunately, none of the R packages (xtable, hwriter, R2HTML) use this markup, as a result of which the DataTables plugin is unable to style these tables.

It should be fairly straightforward patching the code in any of these packages, however I am not sure if any of them are under active development.

Best,
Ramnath

messages.subject: Re: DataTables in Shiny?
parts:
I started playing around with a Javascript library for rendering tables called Slickgrid. I put a very simple demo here:
  http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winstontest/slickgrid/

Package:
  https://github.com/wch/shiny-slickgrid
Code for test app:
  https://github.com/wch/testapp/tree/master/slickgrid

The shiny-slickgrid package has only very basic functionality right now, but Slickgrid itself is very capable. See:
  https://github.com/mleibman/SlickGrid/wiki/Examples.

I'm not planning on doing anything else with shiny-slickgrid it in the near future, but perhaps the code will be useful for you to see how to wire things together. (The test app may require the latest development version of Shiny.)

-Winston
